{"reason":"Replace the narrow second-branch condition with an OR of forecast bias and market-signal mismatch. This fixes the listed errors (bias 0.065–0.081 and mismatch=#t) affecting v1’s 0.708 accuracy/0.607 recovery-rate, while retaining every prior supplier-delay and >0.1-bias classification, protecting recovered amount.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
